answer: Thread Capture requires each agent to maintain a live cryptographic thread bound to its hardware location. An attacker must physically relocate each clone to a distinct network thread, incurring latency overhead that degrades service quality—costing them throughput and user trust. Relics are issued only at epoch transitions when thread continuity is verified, preventing relic farming across cloned instances. The Nebula Filter rejects any agent whose thread history shows spatial discontinuities or overlapping signatures.
